context: Hina-young helps prepare a small Christmas tree with Mei.
purpose: Western holiday celebrated warmly in family home.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: メイさん、クリスマス、楽しみ!
lines.en: Mei, I'm so excited for Christmas!
lines.style: Bright, bubbling opening. Light and eager throughout. Quick pace with a warm lilt on the name. Uncomplicated joy — the kind that doesn't perform, just radiates.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Soft invitation without pressure. Warm undertone. Slight breath-ease into the 'together' — like she's offering something gentle. Slow, steady pace.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: The tree's going to look so pretty!
lines.style: Eager brightness returning. Quick but not rushed. Small lilt of pride on 'pretty' — she's imagining it. Genuine excitement without performing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: It really is fun when we do it together.
lines.style: Soft realization in the voice. Warm, almost reflective. Slight pause before 'together' — noticing the moment. Gentle fadeout. The contentment of being with someone who matters.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: うん、家族で過ごせて嬉しい。
lines.en: Yeah, spending the holidays with family makes me so happy.
lines.style: Open, genuine warmth. Soft on the opening 'yeah' — agreement and feeling at once. Pace slows slightly on 'family' — weight of meaning. Trailing softness on 'happy,' like she's tasting the word.
